description: This file is a Storybook story for a React component called 'Board'. It defines custom components and demonstrates usage with various props, including custom headers, cards, and templates, for a Trello-like board UI.

classes.name: NewCard
classes.description: A React component for adding new cards, with input fields for title and description, and handlers for adding or canceling.

methods.name: updateField
methods.description: Updates the component's state with the value from input fields.

methods.name: handleAdd
methods.description: Calls the onAdd prop with the current state to add a new card.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the input fields and buttons for adding a new card.
